job.title: Software Development Engineer (Audible)
job.pay_full: $110,500 – $160,000 a year base salary (Cambridge, MA), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: This Software Development Engineer role is with Audible, the audio storytelling company that produces and shares audiobooks and other audio stories with millions of listeners worldwide. It suits a hands-on problem solver who wants to grow new skills alongside a knowledgeable team.
duties: Develop, test and maintain software components and applications for Audible's listeners
Find and fix defects through code review, log analysis, metrics, debugging and other troubleshooting
Write maintainable, scalable code as part of an agile engineering team
Work with stakeholders to design, build, test and launch customer-focused software
Apply computer science and engineering principles to moderate-scale problems
Keep improving testability, operational excellence and documentation for the components you own
Handle data classification, storage and management in line with company policy
Take part in interviews and mentor fellow engineers
needs: Experience with at least one modern language such as Java, Python, C++ or C#, including object-oriented design
Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science
nice: Experience with distributed, multi-tiered systems, algorithms and relational databases
Previous technical internship(s) or demonstrated project experience
Experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), SQL and NoSQL databases, AI tools for development productivity, open-source contributions and/or version control
details.benefits: Base salary $110,500 – $160,000 a year in Cambridge, MA. The Amazon package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, basic life and AD&D insurance with optional supplemental life plans, an employee assistance program, mental health support, a medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Workplace accommodations are available during the application and hiring process for candidates with disabilities
